name: Latvia
notes: Depth: seed. Scope: national; register = 5 NUTS 3 regions and 43 pašvaldības (LAU). First pass R001 (2026-11-04). Progressive income tax and the 'solidarity tax' (a social-contribution rate on high income, nicknamed the 'rich people's tax') are excluded; the only wealth-tax supporters found are the 2013 Left-Wing Patriots petition and one MEP's vote. Map: Eurostat GISCO LAU 2024 (units) and NUTS 2024 level 3 (regions), CC BY 4.0, codes are Eurostat LAU codes (units). Seats tab: 15th Saeima seats by list (unlit: no supporter sits in the Saeima).

polls.scope: Adults (15+) in Latvia (Flash Eurobarometer 562, 27 EU countries, n=1,007 in Latvia, n=25,793 in total)
polls.question: Support for a minimum tax based on wealth for the wealthiest individuals (top 0.001%)
polls.commissioned_by: European Commission, DG Taxation and Customs Union
